findings.description: reraise() now replaces a TryAgain failure with its __cause__ or __context__. This changes what callers receive when retries are exhausted. The `from None` also discards the chain that explains why the cause was raised.
findings.rationale: Trigger: user code raises TryAgain, retries are exhausted with reraise=True, and the last attempt's TryAgain has an incidental __context__. Mechanism: reraise raises the context exception instead of TryAgain, and `from None` sets __suppress_context__ and drops the chain. Impact: callers catching TryAgain no longer see it, and may see an unrelated exception that was only being handled at the time. The raised exception is also altered.
